notes.title: Death Skid Marks++
notes.notes:
DeathSkidMarks Update (1.25)

[Release Notes]
- Improved graphic assets by up-scaling all images using machine learning 
  comparison: https://www.jsr-productions.com/deathskidmarksx.html
- Improved loading time
- Improved audio blend (voices versus musics)

[Notes]
- The old version (1.21) is still there.
- The new version is "DeathSkidMarks++" (1.25).
- When you click "Play" on Steam, you will see a launcher pop-up where you can select the new or old version: "Play Death Skid Marks" versus "Launch (old version)"
- 1.21 and 1.25 uses the same "save game".
- Tested and run on Windows 7 & Windows 10

notes.title: Fission Superstar X
notes.notes:
Do you enjoy linear roguelites like Death Skid Marks? Are you curious to see what next game came from one of the crazy guys behind DSM? Do you like beating hard games to show your supremacy to your friends?

If you answered YES to any of the above, here is a link to Fission Superstar X, the next game from our sister studio Turbo Pelvis 3000 inc.

It has the same art guy as Death Skid Marks but more ships, space and nuclear celebrities.

Coming January 31st 2019.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/793680/Fission_Superstar_X/

notes.title: Friday February the 20th, first content patch.
notes.notes:
Friday the 20th we will release the 1.10 version of Death Skid Marks. 

This version will feature our first new content patch.

This will include:

A new kind of weapons called the super weapons. There are 8 of those, 4 melee and 4 ranged. Those are pretty unique, exotic, expensive and, most of all, deadly.

The player will be able to buy those at special shops.

The ai, unfortunately for you all, will be able to use those as well. However only one type of enemy will wield those: the geeks.

The geeks can appear in regular cars or can attack you by themselves, in which case they are as deadly as the groupies.

We have also included a new type of mini game which will spice things up even more with total randomization.

The number of bumper stickers have doubled.

And finally, we have included some tiny requests and bug fixes.

notes.title: Version 1.03 (Update)
notes.notes:
Hi,

We received your feedback and suggestions.

Here is the changelist from versions 1.01-1.03:

[Contents]
- New Road Background.
- Add flac format for the soundtrack.
- Update the mp3 files at 320 kbps.
- Stereo options.

[Bugs fixed]
- Bumper Sticker: Lost money when you go back to the main menu.
- Shield Car: Drain money after the level is over (panels) and you pressed mouse button.
- Hiker duplicates (except for the horsemask "fallback").
- Ambulance/Truck lose their invincibility (rear part) after healing.
- Game won't start: Email us or use the "Bug reporting forum" if you still get this one.

Some people didn't get the sound (only the music/voice). So we did some modification on the sound engine and this version should fix the problem.
If you still get the same problem, try to disable the stereo options in the Option Menu.

Thanks,

JS.

notes.title: Last good news before launch!
notes.notes:
We have added a mad science lab.

The lab is a place where you can drop one of you buddies. You then decide for how many levels (road segments) he is experimented upon, the longer you leave him there, the higher are your chances that he'll get nice results.

After this duration you can pick him up and then you have a description of the experiments performed and the results.

So along with the workshop, this is a good way to give you an edge if fortune does not favor you with good weapons, tasks or items.

Those last additions were actually ideas that we had a while back and that we did not think would make it in the game prior to launch due to time. The good news is that they're in now. The bad news is that our list of ideas is complete for now and that nothing else will be added before launch.

notes.title: New content before release.
notes.notes:
Well well... it seems that semi-trucks will be populating route 666 at launch after all.

As all the cars they come in different flavors. You will also be able to blow up their trailers separately. As far as difficulty goes, they offer a nice change of pace but they're far from being bad news. They fit right in with what we already have.

There is a good chance that this won't be the last good news before the 21st.
